announcements.title: Welcome to Announcements
announcements.body: Watchio now has a dedicated inbox for feature news, maintenance notices, and important alerts.

announcements.title: TV Performance Improvements
announcements.body: Movies and Series now load progressively for faster browsing on Android TV and Fire TV devices.

announcements.title: What's New in Watchio v0.1.4 🎉
announcements.body:
We've been working hard to make Watchio even better!

• Automatic update checks when Watchio starts
• New in-app announcements
• Improved Search and filtering
• Improved Series and episode loading
• Better Refresh experience across Live TV, Movies & Series
• Improved TV remote navigation and focus
• Better layouts across phones and TVs
• General performance and stability improvements

Thanks for using Watchio! ❤️
